response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack/systems engineer with strong software craftsmanship credentials, but his background shows no evidence of experimentation platforms, A/B testing infrastructure, growth engineering, telemetry/metrics systems, or feature-flagging work at scale. His experience is broadly generalist (web, mobile, embedded, GIS) rather than focused on the specialized growth/experimentation domain this Principal-level role demands, and there's no indication of leading multi-team initiatives or cross-functional stakeholder alignment at the scale required.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse technical experience across web, mobile, desktop and embedded systems
Strong open-source and community contributions, including conference talks and workshops
Demonstrated experience with high-performance/low-latency systems (Dlang, async I/O) at Dunnhumby
concerns: No demonstrated experience with experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, or feature-flagging systems
No evidence of growth engineering, telemetry/metrics platforms, or rollout-risk management work
Career trajectory shows generalist/full-stack roles rather than Principal-level technical leadership driving multi-team platform initiatives

key_factors.factor: No evidence of cross-team technical leadership at Principal/IC6 scale
Strong general engineering breadth and craftsmanship
